device.name: Light sheet controller (NI USB-6001 piezo, camera and laser TTL)

facts.text: The controller expects two NI USB-6001 boards as Dev1 and Dev2 and warns that it continues in test mode when either board is absent or is another product type
createTask builds two analog-output tasks: Dev1/ao0 is the piezo channel, Dev1/ao1 the camera TTL, Dev2/ao0 the dither and Dev2/ao1 the laser TTL, each configured from -10.0 to 10.0 V
createTask starts both analog-output tasks and sets stopped to False
startstop from the stopped state recalculates and restarts both tasks; from the running state it stops both tasks, returns the dither to zero and sets stopped to True
refresh recalculates the waveform, stops both tasks, configures continuous sampling and restarts both tasks while the controller is not stopped
gotozero writes a finite zero waveform to the piezo and camera TTL channels, sleeps 0.2 s, stops the task, returns the dither to zero and sets stopped to True
gotoend drives the piezo to maximum_displacement * mV_per_pixel / 1000 V, sleeps 0.2 s, stops the task, returns the dither to zero and sets stopped to True
gotobluelaser sets the blue_laser_on setting to True and gotoyellowlaser sets it to False
calc_ttl writes 6 V on the laser TTL when alternate_lasers is set (in one segment) or when blue_laser_on is true (the whole array), and zeros otherwise
The generated piezo waveform is clamped to -10.0 to 10.0 V and the code asserts the clamp
The settings are mV_per_pixel in mV/pixel, maximum_displacement and offset in pixels, nSteps as a count, step_duration and flyback_duration in ms, total_cycle_period in s and dither_amp in mV
start_light_sheet_controller builds a Qt application, checks the NI devices and constructs MainGui
calc_waveforms imports numpy, scipy.ndimage and QtWidgets from qtpy
The controller module imports numpy, PyDAQmx, qtpy and pyqtgraph
Settings loads ~/.lightsheet/config.p with pickle and uses defaults only after an IOError
dither_gotozero computes calc_ttl, stops task two, writes with timeout -1, briefly starts it and stops it again
